items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: INTERVIEWER mentions 'Open the Door Richard' and 'St. James Infirmary'; INTERVIEWEE clarifies 'Open the Door Richard' was a comedian, Dusty Fletcher

ctx.x: The Baby Grand, was one,... and that was an institution. Of course they had a show. Nipsy Russell was there for 12 years, 12 straight years on one job. And, let's see, Bouman's, which was up on 155th Street. They had, you know, a band and they had a show. And, oh, the Apollo Bar, where, you know, I told you I worked there with Johnny Kirby. The same routine. The band and the shake dancer, then they had the singer, you know, yeah.

One of the things I wanted to get into, of course, was your recording history. And with both, I think, of your earliest recordings, I think, were both...actually featured vocalists, 'Open the Door Richard' and 'St. James Infirmary'.

Well 'Open the Door Richard' was a comedian, Dusty Fletcher, you see. And how that happened, Jack McVea had made a record on the coast and it was caught on fire and so we had to record this right quick. And that's how I did that with him. Then I did a week in the Baby Grand
